what: Full-bleed photo slider — when the 5s progress line fills, it moves to the next slide in 1s (a curve that starts slowly and drags out the end). Background photos change overlapped by their distance from the center. The work titles line up beside the center at a spacing of ‹ the larger of half the screen width and the longest title + 40px › and slide along together — only the center title is solid, the side ones are .4. The picture inside the small center window shifts sideways by the window width each time, so it changes at a different speed from the outer background. Clicking a side title jumps to that slide, a horizontal drag over 25px advances one slide, and the progress line pauses while a hand is over a title or button. It loops endlessly

options.gap: Title spacing = Screen width × gap (minimum longest title + space), default .5
